title: NER-D: A cross-domain benchmark for German NER
abstract: arXiv:2611.18257v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present NER-D, a cross-domain benchmark for German NER comprising 13 datasets spanning 9 domains, including General/Politics, Wikipedia, Legal, Medical, Historical, Financial, Agriculture and Archaeology. We examine the performance of both proprietary LLMs and state-of-the-art small open-source models using normal prompting and further examine the performance gains achievable via in-context learning and LoRA fine-tuning. Our results show that without any sort of optimization a proprietary model (GPT-5.4 mini) outperforms the smaller open-source models on 6 out of 13 datasets, but LoRA fine-tuning enables the smaller models to substantially outperform the proprietary baseline. We further analyze the influence of the domain and the tagset used in each task on the performance achieved in the different evaluation settings. translated_title: NER-D：一个面向德语命名实体识别的跨领域基准
translated_abstract: 我们提出了 NER-D，一个面向德语命名实体识别（NER）的跨领域基准，包含横跨 9 个领域的 13 个数据集，领域涵盖通用/政治、维基百科、法律、医疗、历史、金融、农业和考古学。我们通过普通提示方法考察了专有 LLM 与最先进的小型开源模型的性能，并进一步研究了通过上下文学习和 LoRA 微调所能获得的性能提升。我们的结果表明，在不进行任何优化的情况下，专有模型（GPT-5.4 mini）在 13 个数据集中的 6 个上优于较小的开源模型，但 LoRA 微调能够使较小的模型大幅超越专有模型基线。我们进一步分析了领域以及每个任务中使用的标签集对不同评估设置下性能的影响。该基准将作为资源公开发布，用于未来在通用及专门领域开发德语 NER 方法。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个覆盖 9 个领域、包含 13 个数据集的德语 NER 跨领域基准 NER-D，并发现经 LoRA 微调的小型开源模型能大幅超越专有 LLM 的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces NER-D, a cross-domain benchmark for German NER spanning 13 datasets across 9 domains, showing that LoRA fine-tuning enables small open-source models to substantially outperform proprietary LLMs.
